targetedValidation.exactQuestion: Are arenas 2-4 physically equivalent to arena 1 under the authored +384 X translation for plot, lobby, team pads, walls, spawn/view locations and reset footprint?
targetedValidation.result: Gameplay/loading region: 126,976 relative blocks per replica are equivalent when absent canonical air subchunks are interpreted as air; 0 material gameplay-volume mismatches. Lobby regions differ by 131/167/141 blocks, almost entirely barrier↔air, but no team-pad cell differs, every team pad remains reachable, and no walkable lobby escape was found.

targetedValidation.exactQuestion: Can permitted movement, mayfly or building escape the intended arena/plot, reach another arena, or interact with protected adjacent gameplay?
targetedValidation.result: PROVEN as BUG-BAD-PHYSICAL-ARENA-ESCAPE. During playing, mayfly is granted to all participants and voxel traversal from builder/guesser spawns reaches outside the arena bounds on all four replicas.

targetedValidation.exactQuestion: Can all four arenas start, load, play, transition, reset and finish concurrently at intended maximum occupancy without stalls, command failure or cross-arena mutation?
After runtime/script reload with four arenas in different phases, does each restore only its own membership, roles, ticking area, plot state, timer and result ownership?
Does the actual deployment enable multiplayer despite MultiplayerGame=0 and MultiplayerGameIntent=0 in the selected level.dat?

evidence: No mismatch intersects any configured team-pad volume.
